description: Register the current guest player as a Smart Lottery customer account. On success the caller's identity is upgraded to a registered customer (PLAYER_QUERY_OWN + customerRef); the session token must then be re-minted before any own-scoped call.

customerRef.description: Stable reference for the newly registered customer.

accountState.description: Post-call identity state of the caller.

tokenRefreshRequired.description: True when registration upgraded the principal and the session token is now stale. The agent re-mints (reason=refresh) before the next own-scoped call, skipping the self-healing 409 round-trip. Additive/optional — older responses that omit it still validate.
